# shelf_easy

**Tag**: client, server, shelf, eval, codepush, web, database, serialization, tooling

## 简介

This library includes a json model generator, a unified database operator interface, a server and client framework, a language localization module, and a log module.

## 官网

- 源码仓库: https://github.com/yangfanyu/shelf_easy
